rationales.deterministic-orchestration-v2: form (a) + form (b) + form (c) — top-level code advances a fixed four-phase waterfall (Basic Info Sync → Code Review → Code Alignment → Document), dispatches role-playing LLM agents for bounded conversations within those phases, and deterministically routes QA-Checker outcomes: a below-threshold response triggers another instructed generation, while acceptance or the maximum-turn limit ends the loop.
